leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a sliding window to traverse a string and track character frequencies.
Initialize and update a hash map to maintain counts of characters within the current window.
Apply the condition to determine when the window can be expanded or must be contracted.
Manipulate the window boundaries to maximize its length while respecting the replacement limit.
Construct the complete algorithm to compute the length of the longest substring after replacements.
Integrate the algorithm into a function that accepts a string and an integer k as parameters.
Control the flow of the solution to return the correct maximum length.
